sql: SELECT log_attributes['request.path'] AS path, count() AS calls, countIf(toInt32OrZero(log_attributes['response.status_code']) >= 400) AS errors, round(avg(toFloat64OrZero(log_attributes['response.origin_time'])),2) AS avg_origin_ms FROM logs WHERE source = 'edge_logs' AND log_attributes['request.path'] IN ('/rest/v1/clubs','/rest/v1/music_genres','/rest/v1/music_media','/rest/v1/platform_admins','/rest/v1/forum_global_roles','/rest/v1/music_archive_editors','/rest/v1/notifications') GROUP BY path ORDER BY calls DESC

public_music_genres.reason: Stable public taxonomy; create/update/delete Server Actions already immediately expire the music-genres tag.
public_music_genres.expected_effect: Under steady traffic, time-based refreshes fall from roughly 60 to roughly 1 per hour per effective cache entry, excluding explicit invalidation, cold starts and separate cache partitions.
public_music_genres.out_of_band_edits: Direct database changes outside the admin actions may remain cached until the next timed revalidation.

decision.music_media_and_clubs: Retain current 60-second public cache and session-scoped/RLS-bound private reads; do not infer a live loop from historical totals.
decision.duplicate_chat_notification_provider: Reproduced two UI defects with nested real providers: two browser permission requests and separate open-conversation state. Fixed ChatNotificationProvider to reuse an existing parent; standalone visitor layouts still create an owner. No duplicated network connection claimed.

verification.browser: Existing authenticated Chrome tab navigated from /comunidades to /musica; album catalog, club cards and genre groups rendered.

scope: Local source change only. No deployment, production writes, auth/RLS changes or unrelated refactor.

follow_up_code_review.note: Genre cache was already implemented. Subsequent provider correction is source code, not a JSON configuration change.
